result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I only compiled `codeanalyzer`, which succeeded, and didn't run any tests.

In `getAllTeams` in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, the remainder condition is now `!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)`.

Unmatched contributors whose latest commit is older than 180 days are left out. Blank latest-commit dates count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for them. Configured teams are unchanged.

When no teams are configured, `getAllTeams` still returns every contributor, active or not.
